scope: Read-only source, checker and literal-evidence review. No check script, compiler, SDK, build, UI or Simulator operation.

rootCause.query: Unique TextView a11y-circuit-search, descendant of a11y-circuit-list in the R3 tree.
rootCause.notFailed: Enabled was true. The frame ends at the viewport top. The R3 guard rejected preparation before a reveal gesture.
rootCause.limit: The evidence does not prove a persistent absence of the canonical label, a gesture consumer, or success after revealing.

proof: The pure readiness first rejects disabled, nonfinite, zero and negative raw dimensions.
A contained control is admissible only with canonical label and dimensions of at least 48 points. Native hittability is then queried and required by the unchanged final action path.
A control outside or partly outside the viewport may prepare; this does not set fullyVisible true unless all admission requirements pass.
All three public-selected Components return paths also require canSkipSelected. That flag preserves canonical label, enabled state and minimum 48-point dimensions even offscreen.
The single Components tap and fresh posttap confirmation remain intact, without a retap path.
The actual query, native roles and ambiguity guard are byte-identical to the base; the real XCUI query is not executed by the host probe.
The 62-step case prefix and Start/Complete/text suffix are byte-identical to the base.
The checker extracts the actual readiness source and uses the literal R3 frame and observation. It pins the three complete literal inputs and fixed canonical EN/PT values.

The checker includes 17 literal expectations, including independent offscreen wrong-label and undersized-canonical skip negatives. It verifies the actual printed count and all input bytes before/after the subprocess.
closedReviewPoints: Pinned full tree/observation/labels hashes rather than relying on a matching fragment.
Added separate offscreen canonical-label and minimum-size skip negatives.
limits: No native success or gesture delivery is claimed.
Host readiness tests do not execute XCUI queries or prove callback delivery.
The existing backward-only reachability and twelve-gesture limit remain unchanged.
